title: hieracium vulgatum subsp. persbergense
intro: Hieracium vulgatum subsp. persbergense, commonly known as Persberg Hawkweed, is a subspecies of the Hieracium vulgatum plant, a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Persberg Hawkweed include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
